findings.reader_payoff: The future is perceived as something present resources must bear forward, not only as an external event that happens later.
findings.containment: This is exploratory and form-distant; it is an allocative burden analogy, not a lexical substitution for eating.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
